skills.description_ru: Проектирование API и интерфейсов модулей: контракты, версии, ошибки, обратная совместимость.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).
skills.description_ru: Брейншторм перед реализацией: вопросы заказчику, варианты, выбор подхода до написания кода.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.description: Conducts multi-axis code review. Use before merging any change. Use when reviewing code written by yourself, another agent, or a human. Use when you need to assess code quality across multiple dimensions before it enters the main branch. Use when asked to review a diff or a pull request, even when the diff is pasted inline.
skills.description_ru: Код-ревью по пяти осям: корректность, читаемость, архитектура, безопасность, производительность.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.description: Guides systematic root-cause debugging. Use when tests fail, builds break, something that worked yesterday broke, behavior doesn't match expectations, or you encounter any unexpected error. Use when you need to figure out what broke and why — a systematic approach to finding and fixing the root cause rather than guessing.
skills.description_ru: Отладка и восстановление после ошибок: воспроизведение, изоляция, защита от повторения.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.description: Records decisions and documentation. Use when you need to document an architecture decision (ADR) or the reasoning behind a design choice, when changing public APIs, shipping features, or when you need to record context that future engineers and agents will need to understand the codebase.
skills.description_ru: Документация и ADR: фиксировать решения, README, которые читают.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
skills.description_ru: Выполнение готового плана задача за задачей с фиксацией результата и ревью.

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.description: Optimizes application performance across frontend, backend, queries, and databases. Use when performance requirements exist, when you suspect performance regressions, when Core Web Vitals or load times need improvement, when N+1 query patterns need fixing, or when profiling reveals bottlenecks.
skills.description_ru: Оптимизация производительности: измерить, найти узкое место, исправить, подтвердить цифрами.

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.description: Breaks work into ordered tasks. Use when you have a spec or clear requirements and need to break work into implementable tasks. Use when a task feels too large to start, when you need to estimate scope, or when parallel work is possible.
skills.description_ru: Планирование и декомпозиция задач на проверяемые шаги.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
skills.description_ru: Запрос код-ревью: что проверять, в каком контексте, формат ответа.

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.description: Hardens code against vulnerabilities. Use when auditing an input handler for vulnerabilities, when handling user input, authentication, data storage, or external integrations, or when checking a login flow is safe against the OWASP Top Ten. Use when building any feature that accepts untrusted data, manages user sessions, or interacts with third-party services. Use when auditing dependencies for known vulnerabilities, triaging package-manager audit findings, or assessing supply-chain risk in a new package. Use when personal data or privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA) is involved.
skills.description_ru: Усиление безопасности: входные данные, секреты, зависимости, права, логирование.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
skills.description_ru: Системная отладка: сначала корневая причина, потом исправление; воспроизведение, гипотезы, проверка.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
skills.description_ru: TDD: красный тест → минимальный код → рефакторинг; запрещает писать код без падающего теста.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
skills.description_ru: Изолированная работа в git worktree: ветка на задачу, без конфликтов с основной копией.

skills.name: vercel-composition-patterns
skills.description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.
skills.description_ru: Паттерны композиции React-компонентов: compound components, слоты, контекст без prop drilling.

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
skills.description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.
skills.description_ru: 70 правил производительности React и Next.js от Vercel: водопады запросов, бандл, рендеринг, кэш.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
skills.description_ru: Проверка перед словом «готово»: запустить тесты и показать вывод, а не утверждать.

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
skills.description_ru: Ревью интерфейса по Web Interface Guidelines: доступность, UX, формы, состояния.

skills.name: writing-guidelines
skills.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".
skills.description_ru: Правила письменной речи для документации и интерфейсов: ясность, краткость, структура.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
skills.description_ru: План реализации по шагам с проверяемыми результатами — для себя или другого агента.
